subject: Cross-team CI & artifact addons procurement plan (Buildkite + Registry add-ons)
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@buildkite.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah@procurenow.com
Date: 2026-10-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal quote: Buildkite Enterprise + Registry retention/scanning add-ons

Hi Rishi / Marissa —

Thanks for the time on Friday. Per our conversation I’ve attached a consolidated quote for Buildkite Enterprise renewal (standard seat-based + 24/7 support) and the Container Registry add-ons you evaluated (advanced image scanning + extended retention). Key points:

- One-year renewal, option for 2-year at 7% term discount.
- Buildkite: list price $178k/yr; proposed Redwood price after partner credit $160k/yr.
- Registry add-ons: scanning $36k/yr; extended retention $28k/yr. We can bundle scanning + retention for $58k/yr (5% bundle discount).
- We can include a one-time onboarding credit of $10k if you commit to a 2-year term.

Attachments: BKQ4-renewal-quote.pdf, CR-addon-pricing.xlsx

Timing: Sales needs direction by Oct 20 to hold quoted pricing for Q4 procurement. Let me know if you want a call to walk the SOW redline.

Regards,
Oliver Hayes
Account Exec — Buildkite

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal quote: Buildkite Enterprise + Registry retention/scanning add-ons

Team — forwarding vendor quote. Short version: combined renewal ~$218k/yr (after initial bundle/partner credits), or ~207k/yr if we take 2-year commit and get onboarding credit.

Questions we need to answer before we brief Finance/Legal:
- Which cost centers should absorb Registry retention vs Buildkite seats? (Registry used by infra + platform teams; Buildkite by product eng)
- Can we reduce Buildkite concurrency or agent footprint to lower the seat tier? Karthik — can you validate current agent utilization (peak vs baseline)?
- If we push to 2-year, what is our appetite for longer commit vs flexibility for capacity changes?

Options I propose (short):
1) Standard 1yr, take bundle, negotiate smaller onboarding credit — fastest.
2) 2yr commit, take onboarding credit, split costs across infra/platform by usage — lower annual cost.
3) Reduce agent footprint + architect change, negotiate seat count down, then 1yr.

Please reply with a recommended option by Wednesday so Marissa can start procurement fixtures. Attaching vendor files (see original attachments from Oliver).

Rishi
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

On Oct 3, 2026, Oliver Hayes wrote:
> Hi Rishi / Marissa —
> 
> Thanks for the time on Friday. Per our conversation I’ve attached a consolidated quote...
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal quote: Buildkite Enterprise + Registry retention/scanning add-ons

Rishi — quick tech read: we should be able to avoid the higher Buildkite seat tier if we optimize agent utilization and enable auto-scale policies that are already supported in our cluster. I pulled last quarter's utilization and attached a short CSV.

Notes:
- Peak concurrency is driving the current seat tier; ~65% of peaks are from a handful of scheduled integration pipelines that can be shifted to off-peak windows.
- Registry retention: we currently retain images for 90 days in prod. Moving to 30–60 day retention for non-critical artifacts would cut storage bill ~30% and reduce add-on tier pressure.
- Scanning: we should keep scanning for critical images only; policy-based sampling reduces monthly scans by ~40% without materially increasing risk.

If procurement wants to buy everything as-is, we can present a roadmap to reduce cost over 3 months and push for a short-term seat hold with a clause to revisit usage after Q1.

Attachment: agent-utilization-report.csv

Karthik
Head of Platform Reliability

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-06T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-team CI & artifact addons procurement plan (Buildkite + Registry add-ons)

Thanks — procurement checklist and timeline below. I’ll start the PO path once we pick option.

Procurement items:
- PO + signed SOW required for registry add-ons. Legal to review vendor redlines; expect 3 business days if no unusual clauses.
- Finance needs: cost center allocation, GL codes, and whether this is capex or opex (we recommend opex).
- Discount asks we should push for: 10% multi-year; waiving onboarding fees; 60-day invoice terms. Oliver has already proposed a $10k onboarding credit for 2yr — push for that on 1yr too.
- If we split costs across teams, we need headcount/usage table to attach to PO. Karthik — can you produce rough % usage by end of day?

Related link: HubSpot deal BK-CR-2026-Q4-0891 (I’ll update pipeline).

Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-07T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-team CI & artifact addons procurement plan (Buildkite + Registry add-ons)

Decision: proceed with vendor negotiation on Option 2 (2-year commit) contingent on two items:
1) Buildkite confirms onboarding credit ($10k) locked in writing for the 2-year deal.
2) Registry vendor accepts a 30-day review clause to allow us to tune retention/scanning policy after first 90 days (no punitive overage for first 90 days).

Action items:
- Marissa: open SOW negotiation threads with both vendors and ask for written onboarding credit for 2yr.
- Karthik: finalize usage percentages by EOD (for cost-split).
- Dev: Finance pre-approval for splitting across infra/product cost centers and approval for 2yr commit if net annual cost <= $205k/yr.

I’ll copy Procurement/Legal in the vendor call once Marissa has redlines.

Rishi

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-07T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: conditional for 2yr commit and cost split

Rishi / Marissa —

Finance can provisionally approve the 2-year commitment under conditions below:
- Net annual spend must be <= $205,000 after applied onboarding credit and bundle discounts.
- Cost allocation table (by team) must be provided and approved by respective managers before PO.
- We will not prepay beyond 90 days without VP approval.

I’m fine to proceed to negotiation with Buildkite and Containermart on those terms. Please prepare a short memo for VP Ops (I’ve attached the template).

Attachment: procurement-approval-memo.pdf

Dev Patel
Finance Manager, Platform Spend
